findings.title: Colour contrast, focus order and alt-text quality have not been checked
findings.evidence: The analysis reads the served HTML: it neither computes styles nor navigates with a keyboard, so it cannot measure real contrast ratio (WCAG 1.4.3), focus order (2.4.3) or whether an alt text actually describes the image (1.1.1).
findings.recommendation: Complete this with a manual review and a browser tool (axe DevTools, Lighthouse). This section covers the criteria that leave a trace in the markup, not full conformance with EN 301 549.

findings.title: Server-side measurement cannot be verified from the HTML
findings.evidence: Static analysis cannot see runtime requests.
findings.recommendation: Run the Playwright worker with network capture to list the real measurement calls.

findings.title: Analytics is configured but only loads after consent
findings.evidence: data-ga-id='G-FIXTURE0000' and a consent banner (data-consent); no tracker in the initial HTML.
findings.recommendation: Nothing to fix: this is what consent-first measurement looks like from outside. NOT VERIFIED from static HTML — that the tag really fires after «Accept» can only be confirmed by loading the page in a browser and accepting (`POST /api/audits/{id}/deep` with `analytics_live`).

findings.title: Could not check whether the server offers Brotli
findings.evidence: La sonda HEAD con Accept-Encoding: br devolvio 200 sin Content-Encoding (many servers do not compress bodyless responses)
findings.recommendation: Check by hand with: curl -sI -H 'Accept-Encoding: br' <url>

findings.title: Shop and booking checks were not applied
findings.recommendation: These checks (Product markup, shipping and returns policy, booking engine, menu) only make sense for a site that sells or takes bookings. Nothing here counts against the score.

findings.title: Call-to-action contrast and visibility not checked in this pass

findings.title: Urgency or scarcity messages detected
findings.recommendation: Check the scarcity is real. False scarcity breaches EU consumer law (Directive 2005/29/EC, Annex I) and destroys trust.

findings.title: Brand consistency across pages not checked

findings.title: Dark mode is not expected for this audience

findings.title: TLS certificate expiry and chain not checked in this pass
findings.evidence: The capture uses the system CA store; it inspects neither dates nor chain.
findings.recommendation: Run the TLS worker (sslyze or `openssl s_client`) for expiry date, protocol version and cipher suites.
